nadir.desc: The property consists of a single commercial building with a gray shingle roof|A paved parking area surrounds the structure|Adjacent commercial buildings are present on multiple sides|The property is located in a commercial area near major roadways.

alpha.desc: The front of the facility shows a commercial building with a green exterior and prominent signage reading "TOP SHELF WELLNESS CENTER." A paved parking area is located directly in front of the entrance|Windows and entry doors are visible along the facade.

bravo.desc: The left side of the facility shows the side elevation of the commercial building with a gray shingle roof|Portions of the paved parking area and adjacent structures are visible|Vehicles are present in nearby parking spaces.

charlie.desc: The rear of the facility shows the back elevation of the commercial building|Paved parking and adjacent structures continue around this side|Vehicles are present in the surrounding lot.

delta.desc: The right side of the facility shows the side of the commercial building and paved parking areas|Adjacent commercial structures are present|Vehicles and circulation space continue around this side of the property.

considerations: Vehicle access is available via access points in both the front and rear of the commercial building. The parking lot provides space for emergency vehicle circulation and staging. Multiple vehicles currently occupy portions of the lot. Adjacent commercial buildings are close on multiple sides. The compact commercial layout allows relatively direct access to the front entrance, though side access may be limited by neighboring structures and parking.
clarifications: Where are the primary vehicle entrances to the parking area, and are any of them gated or restricted?
